newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 17.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- Police suspect the attackers of high profile North defector, Li Il-nam, were sent by Pyongyang, based on evidence that the shooters used weapons standard for North Korean agents

- South Korea has been put on high terrorism alert following the execution-style shooting on Saturday of Li Il-nam, a relative of North Korean leader Kim Jong-il, who had defected to the South in 1982.
- Government ordered tighter security for defectors and government leaders.
- Government has postponed the visit of a reactor survey team to North Korea until Pyongyang gaurantees their security.
